# `aitbc wallet delete`

Delete a locally stored wallet with an optional confirmation prompt.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet delete [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Wallet name. |
| `--confirm` | flag | `false` | no | Skip confirmation prompt |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet delete --name <name>
```
